arguments.command:
cd /home/user/project/preview && python - <<'EOF'
import re
p='index.html'; s=open(p).read()

# 1. keep stroke weights honest under the non-uniform SVG scaling
s = s.replace('<svg viewBox="0 0 320 78" preserveAspectRatio="none" focusable="false">',
              '<svg viewBox="0 0 320 78" preserveAspectRatio="none" focusable="false"\n             style="vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke">')

# add vector-effect attribute to every stroked/path/line/circle/rect inside marker svg
start = s.index('<g data-marker="scientific">')
end   = s.index('</svg>', start)
block = s[start:end]
block2 = re.sub(r'<(line|path|circle|rect)\b', r'<\1 vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke"', block)
s = s[:start] + block2 + s[end:]

# 2. CSS: belt-and-braces so hairline strokes stay hairlines when the SVG stretches
s = s.replace('body[data-mode="date"]       [data-marker="date"] { display: inline; }',
 'body[data-mode="date"]       [data-marker="date"] { display: inline; }\n'
 '.band__marker svg * { vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke; }')
open(p,'w').write(s)
print(s.count('vector-effect'))
EOF
grep -n 'vector-effect' index.html
